rv.q: This new offering by Chicago’s Renaissance Man is both entertaining and exhilarating.
Jones in particular proves why he is one of Chicago's most vibrant theatrical treasures.
Scary Town is a delightful surprise: layered, smart, emotionally resonant, and visually inventive.
For those that are usual fans of Hell in a Handbag productions, Scary Town would most likely be another one that you’d enjoy because it has the company’s signature style.

cn.t: Hell in a Handbag delivers a campy, heartfelt coming-of-age tale that parodies Richard Scarry's Busytown with adult twists. Critics praise the wonderfully weird, personal story and signature outrageous humor, calling it another winning world premiere.
